content: Enrollment/waitlist domain conventions: capacity is a hard constraint; on full, either block or waitlist. Promotion policy choice: auto-enroll next FIFO (simple, free/fast classes) vs time-limited offer with expiry (needs timers, notifications, accept/decline, expiry sweeps). Strict FIFO is the defensible baseline; priority points, admin override, overbooking, group bookings and transfers are named exceptions that add policy surface. dcb.events 'Course subscriptions' example already models course capacity + per-student cap with courseId/studentId tags.
